The government has high hopes.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 32 ([[Translated#Dialogue|Translated Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Breaker4''' is an enemy that appears in [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], [[Molten Mode|Molten]], [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]], [[Challenge Trials]] and [[PVP]] modes. It has a decent amount of health, average speed and 35% defense. Upon death, it will spawn three [[Breaker3]]s which are invulnerable for a short period of time. These have less health and defense but are faster and can spawn one [[Breaker2]] upon death, which in turn can spawn one [[Breaker]] upon death. This will create huge hordes of enemies, which can easily overwhelm unprepared players. The '''Breaker4''' can/could be spawned by the [[Mystery Summoner]], [[Necromancer Boss]] and [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] if the map has the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier. The [[Grave Digger]] also used to summon it in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode on maps with the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier. Otherwise, all these enemies will spawn the [[Mystery Boss]] instead. The '''Breaker4''' replaces the [[Mystery Boss]] in any map with the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier active. The '''Breaker4''' also appeared as part of [[The Classic Event]] and [[The Takeover Event]]. The '''Breaker4''' was replaced by the [[Png Bot4]] in [[Headache Headquarters]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Breaker4''' is a humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. Its torso, waist and legs are purple with a star pattern of varying sizes, orientations and colors of white, pink and dark magenta. Its arms and head are made out of light purple construction paper, with the front and back faces of each part being separate halves held together by small strips of tape. It has four small red humanoids sticking out of its right shoulder, chest, upper right leg and lower left leg, all of which represent the [[Breaker3]]. It plays a low-pitched squeaking sound and emits small waves and purple confetti particles on death. |Legacy |The legacy '''Breaker4''' has a pastel magenta skin color. It has a dark magenta torso and legs with a plaid stitch mark pattern on them. It has a red humanoid on its chest, representing the [[Breaker3]]. It plays a crumbling sound on death. }} ==Strategy== *The '''Breaker4''' spawns three [[Breaker3]]s upon death. This can create large hordes of enemies, which can make the '''Breaker4''' quite a dangerous enemy. **As these spawn in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Assassin]], [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Mercenary Base]]'s [[Grenadier]]s or [[Pursuit]] can be used to clear them out easily. ***Towers which deal splash damage can be especially useful, as majority of them bypass defense. **Setting some towers to ''Strongest'' targeting can massively help against the '''Breaker4''' as it avoids the [[Breaker3]]'s (and its subsequent children's) invulnerability frames. **They can be especially threatening in maps with the [[All Paths]] modifier, which increases the amount of them that spawns significantly. **High DPS towers are also recommended, supported by the [[DJ Booth]], [[Medic]] and [[Commander]]. **The [[Hacker]] can also be quite useful—especially in harder gamemodes and [[Challenge Trials]]—as it can prevent the ''Break'' ability from occurring when the '''Breaker4''' is killed while targeted by the [[Hacker]]'s range. *Be aware that you do not earn any cash from damaging enemies that the '''Breaker4''' spawns in every mode. *The enemies that spawn from the '''Breaker4''' do not need to be killed for wave progression to occur. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- !
